text:
Sophie: Quick thread to lock down the "minimum telemetry" for the console launch. Customers keep asking for: cost breakdown per-route, an errors heatmap, and a way to jump to problematic requests.
Diego: Agree we should avoid full distributed tracing in v1. Can we deliver a summarized 'expensive hotspots' panel that links to sampled traces later?
Kaveh: Yes. Proposal: v1 = Dashboards: per-route cost/time buckets, 95th/99th token latency, and Error Heatmap (route x error-type). Tracing = opt-in enterprise feature behind a toggle.
Lina: From infra concerns  telemetry budget is the blocker. We need a default cap and auto-throttle sampling when cost delta > 10% week-over-week.
Sophie: Acceptance criteria (must-haves for GA):
- cost card with per-route token/unit breakdown and trends
- error aggregation with stack peek (top 3 stacks) and jump-to-sample link
- telemetry budget control and visible estimate in UI
Diego: UX note: make the cost card explainable: show top 3 contributors and a 'why this is expensive' bullet list (e.g., long context, large batch, rerun). Not raw spans.
Kaveh: Implementation sketch for sampling config we can expose to customers: 
```
telemetry:
  enabled: true
  mode: "adaptive"
  sampling:
    base_rate: 0.01
    max_rate: 0.2
    budget_pct: 1.0
  trace_tags: ["console_v1","beta"]
```
Lina: Ops constraints: high-cardinality user tags will blow the metrics backend. We should strip or hash free-form fields by default.
Sophie: Rollout plan: 1) internal dogfooding (1 sprint), 2) beta to selected customers (SMB + 2 mid-market) with tracing disabled, 3) Enterprise opt-in for traces (post-beta).
Diego: Gate metrics for beta -> wider: telemetry_cost_weekly_change <= +12% and error_dash_query_latency p50 < 400ms. If either fails, pause and iterate.
Kaveh: Fallback behavior: if sampling pipeline errors, surface degraded counts and last-known examples. No silent failures.
Lina: I'll wire an ops monitor and an autoscale rule: if telemetry_write_ops spikes > 3x baseline, reduce sampling_rate by 50% and alert on-call.
Sophie: Who owns the PRD + mocks? Diego: I'll write the PRD and include the 'why is this expensive' copy. Kaveh: I'll produce the sampling/ingestion design doc and budget guardrails. Lina: I'll add the ops runbook and throttles.
ops-bot: noted  will post deploy status and will set a rollback marker if telemetry_cost_ratio > configured_threshold during rollout.
Sophie: Decision summary: ship dashboards (cost + errors) for general beta; tracing and deep trace-links are Enterprise opt-in. Telemetry budget guardrails enabled by default. Follow-ups: Diego PRD by Wed EOD, Kaveh design doc by Friday.
Diego: I'll also prototype the compact card + expanded modal for the 'stack peek' this sprint.
Kaveh: One more risk: customer-driven 'show me spans' asks will come; prepare a short sales playbook that redirects to opt-in tracing plan and pricing.
Sophie: Good call. OK team, narrow scope + clear guardrails. :thumbsup:
